info.title: Airfare Price Index (APIx) - India Aviation REST API
info.description: Production REST API for real-time domestic airfare index calculation, route price baskets, fare elasticity curves, anomaly alerts, DGCA backtesting, and scraping pipeline monitoring across India's civil aviation corridors.

get.description: Returns current headline index value, 24h/7d/30d change percentages, base period benchmark, and basket overview.
Retrieves continuous 35-day daily index time-series including route-level and airline-level sub-indices.
Returns weekly rolling aggregated price indices with variance.
Returns monthly price indices aligned with DGCA domestic passenger yield reporting periods.
Filterable and paginated real-time and harvested quotes with base fare, taxes, UDF, convenience fee, and anomaly flags.

parameters.name: advanceWindow
parameters.description: Filter by advance purchase window (T+1, T+7, T+15, T+30, T+45)

get.description: Returns all routes in the representative index basket with their dynamic weights, distances, and DGCA shares.

post.description: Allows administrative adjustment of basket weights in the database without code redeployment, triggering real-time index recalculation.

get.description: Returns Indian carriers (IndiGo, Air India, Air India Express, Akasa Air, SpiceJet) with average yield and market shares.
Details active airline direct portals and OTAs with ethical compliance mode, robots.txt status, and rate limits.
Provides machine-learning-derived fare projections with 95% confidence bounds and scheduled aviation events.
Identifies statistical fare spikes, flash drops, and capacity crunches using Z-score and Isolation Forest algorithms.
Curves demonstrating price progression from early-bird T+45 down to departure day T+1 across all basket routes.
Statistical validation comparing calculated APIx index against official DGCA domestic passenger yield benchmarks (correlation, MAPE, RMSE).
Status of automated background scrapers, harvest counts, recent pipeline logs, and adapter health.

post.description: Executes the end-to-end data pipeline (Scrape → Validate → Normalize → Store → Compute Index → Run ML Analytics).
